title: rhysolepis linearifolia
intro: Rhysolepis linearifolia, commonly known as the desert marigold, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its vibrant yellow flowers and potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rhysolepis linearifolia include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to aid in wound healing and infection prevention. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its benefits.
